Job Description: 
   
 GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES

The QlikView Developer will be part of a team that is designing and building the next generation of business intelligence tools that will optimize how our company trains and supports our agent field force and provides executive level users with the data needed to make informed business decisions. This position has the unique opportunity to work closely with business and other IT teams throughout the company in a visible role that involves coordination across teams, mitigating risks and balancing business needs with technical constraints. Candidates must have a strong drive, attention to detail, a collaborative work style, and a passion for solving hard problems as simply as possible. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION
• Work with a cross-functional team of developers and business analysts to deliver on strategic data and analytics initiatives. 
• Partner with business operations teams to support implementation of solutions. 
Define, develop and implement dashboards based on complex data extraction and load architectures. 
• Quickly gather a deep understanding of business need and translate into technology solutions. 
Exploit technologies that result in measurable performance and quality gains. 
Fulfill ad-hoc requests for related data and analysis.
• Create publisher jobs
• Act as evangelist for BI benefits across the organization; promote BI usage to relevant departments.
• Monitoring and maintenance of all components that make up the Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence infrastructure.
• Design, create and tune physical database objects (tables, views, indexes) to support logical and dimensional models. Maintain the referential integrity of the database.
• Design, code, test, and document all new or modified BI applications and programs.
• Help maintain Data Governance guidelines across all of the corporate BI Systems
• Performs other duties as assigned. 

 

 Additional Information: 
   
 ESSENTIAL SKILLS OF THE POSITION
• Minimum 5 years experience developing Business Intelligence (BI) and Analytical Solutions
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• QlikView Experience and knowledge of QlikView Architecture required.
• Ability to utilize scripting language to meet complex business requirements.
• Good problem solving and testing skills. 
• Microsoft SQL experience a plus.  
 Work Environment: 
   
 Environment is very team oriented, and a mix of agile and waterfall methodologies. 
 

 Top Three Skills: 
   
 1. QlikView or Tableau
2. Reporting
3. SQL 

 Apply today!
